sentences.text: The Crime and Corruption Commission set out planned corruption prevention audits for July 2021 to June 2023.
sentences.support: A snapshot of our two-year program of audits for the period 1 July 2021 to 30 June 2023
sentences.section: First year – Planned corruption prevention audits (2021–22)

sentences.text: The first year’s program covered misuse of public resources, recruitment selection and a prevention project whose scope would be determined before it began.
sentences.support:
The scope of the work will be 
determined prior to the commencement date of this project.
sentences.section: First year – Planned corruption prevention audits (2021–22)

sentences.text: The second year’s program covered records of lobbying meetings, employment screening, complaint management and another prevention project.
sentences.support:
Examine how comprehensively public agencies 
and government officials are maintaining 
records of their meetings with lobbyists.
sentences.section: Second year – Planned corruption prevention audits (2022–23)

sentences.text: The planned complaint-management audit would assess investigations, disciplinary decisions and protection against reprisals for complainants.
sentences.support:
This audit will examine the efficacy of 
agencies’ investigations, disciplinary decision-
making

notes: This is a two-page forward audit plan, not a report of completed audits. It has no executive summary or completed-audit findings.
